title: Auditing the ToxCast cytotoxicity filter: bound provenance, testability and coverage (invitrodb v4.3)
description: Analysis pipeline and aggregate outputs for an audit of the chemical-level cytotoxicity lower bound distributed with ToxCast invitrodb v4.3. Classifies every active curve by whether its chemical has an estimated bound or the 1000 uM default ceiling, quantifies how often the comparison is answerable given each curve's tested concentration range, reports target-family tallies within provenance stratum with burst-annotated families flagged, and computes coverage-normalised chemical promiscuity as the fraction of tested families hit. Also includes potency-window, assay-format and severe mc6 flag sensitivity analyses recomputed within the estimated-bound stratum. Requires the public EPA ToxCast invitrodb v4.3 extracts (not redistributed).
